name: classification-preprocessing
description: Processing container for preprocessing nrrd images for classification training/inference

templates.description: Resample and z-score normalize nrrd images into numpy arrays

env.name: PATCH_SIZE
env.description: Target shape (as a Python tuple literal string, e.g. '(128, 128, 128)') the input volume is resampled to before normalization.

env.name: WORKFLOW_NAME
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — gates the untouched legacy inference-only branch that reads a trained model's PATCH_SIZE from /models. Statically overridden per DAG in workflow_definition.py; the default here matches the training DAG, where that branch is never taken.

env.name: TASK_IDS
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — only read when WORKFLOW_NAME contains 'inference', to look up the selected training run's PATCH_SIZE under /models. No dynamic model picker exists yet (see migration-notes.md); set manually via the TASK_IDS workflow_parameter on the inference DAG, shared with the inference task.

inputs.name: nrrd
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.nrrd file.

outputs.name: preprocessed
outputs.description: Creates for each input case a subdirectory with the same identifier containing a single <identifier>.npy file.
